text: Program Description Program Introduction Editor Notes: This program enables students with 0 Chinese language knowledge to learn Chinese program in the first year and then degree programs in DMU directly. 1. Pakistani students who apply for the 1+5 program can apply through CUCAS Pakistan Add: Hest Building Sabzarar Metro Station Bosan Road Multan, Phone number: 00923001330187, Dalian Medical University will check students' information and application documents, those who meet the admission requirements of the program will get scan copy of admission letter from Dalian Medical University first. 2. Students who were accepted by the program will then study the preparatory program in Dalian Medical University for the first year. 3. Those who got HSK 4 certificate with enough scores and passed related tests will enter bachelor degree(5 years) in Dalian Medical University for the following years. Clinical Medicine program is taught in Chinese. Tuition fee is 15000 RMB for the first year preparatory program and 25000 RMB/year for degree program, which is exclusive for CUCAS students. Accommodation fee for this project is about 5000 RMB/year, quad room, no private bath room. Note: The course requires students to pay the tuition or admission deposit before issuing the admission package. Admission Plan: 30 to 60 seats.
